title: Block Relations and Clifford Theory for H-Triples
summary: We study block relations between H-triples of finite groups. We prove a Clifford correspondence theorem in which a single pair of associated projective representations satisfies both the mixed comparison-function identities and the block conditions on every intermediate group. The resulting correspondence preserves relative character heights and yields a common defect group for each pair of corresponding blocks. We also establish induction and gluing results, including an induction criterion that allows unequal Clifford indices. Direct products, wreath products and changes of ambient group…
